events.text: Lancaster, Pennsylvania, serves as the capital of the United States for one day.
Jean-François Champollion announces he has deciphered the Rosetta Stone.
The Stockton and Darlington Railway, the first public steam railway, opens in England.
Albert Einstein's paper introducing E = mc² is received for publication.
Germany, Italy and Japan sign the Tripartite Pact.
The Tonight Show premieres on NBC.
Rachel Carson's book Silent Spring is published.
The Taliban capture Kabul, the capital of Afghanistan.
